title: Louella in a veil, and the invitation to the Club DeLisa
summary: He didn't recognize her dressed up, talked with her at the bar, and she urged him to try her club.

story.theme_name: Chicago: the jazz migration and its clubs
story.community_name: Going north: working the Chicago jazz scene

blocks.x: I was gettin' me a drink, an I happen to look around and I say, "Isn't that somebody"..I said, "I know her."

So she was sittin' up there drinkin' a champagne. She didn't drink but she was just sippin' on some champagne. So she looked good so I turned...so I just...mosey on over and see who this is. So when I got over there to her, (she) said, "You don't remember me?"
I say, "No. No, I don't know who you...Who're you?"

I say, "Well, bless my soul, honey. I never would have recognized you, you look so sharp. I didn't know who you was. All I know is you a good lookin' woman so I wanna say somethin' to ya. Didn't know how to say it. But I was just gonna come over and offer you to have another glass of champagne."
Said, "I don't need no more champagne because I don't drink anyway." Say, "But you can sit down and talk to me."

So I sit down there for awhile, and I talked 'bout an hour. I was drinkin' like a fish. Get one scotch and soda, another ran right after another one. I couldn't figure why she didn't drink nothin' but that darned champagne.
I say, "Don't you wanna drink o' whiskey?"
Say, "Naw, I don't drink no whiskey."
So I say, "Well, okay, so'm I'm goin' back here and do my show. You gonna leave?"
She say, "No, I'll be here. I come to see the show." She say, "Why don't you get a job over where I work at?"

I say, 'Well, T-Bone Walker got that sewed up.' I say, 'He beat me to the joint.' I said, 'He been there off an' on for four or five years. Ever' time you look around, he's playin' at the place.'
She say, 'Well, you could work over there, too, if you'd come over and talk to the boss.'
I told her, 'Well, you introduce me to him sometime when I come over there.'
'They have breakfast shows in the mornin'...on Sunday mornin!'
So I say, 'Well, I be over there this comin' Sunday mornin' after we get off. You introduce me to the boss.'
Said, 'Okay, be sure and do that.' She set there for awhile... say, 'Well, I'm leavin' now. I'm goin' home. What time'll you be home?'
I say, 'Well, I ain't got nothin' else t'do but come on home when I get through here.' Had a nightclub called the Club DeLisa... stayed open all night. I say, 'Well...' It was a big nightclub. I said, 'Looka here...'
Say, 'What...?'
'Why don't ya come over to the Club DeLisa with me and see the early floorshow?'
She say, 'Well, all right, I'll come over there wi' cha. But, in the meantime, I got to run home, check on somethin' an' I'll be back when you get off.'
I say, 'Aw, you ain't comin' back.'
Say, 'Yes, I'll be back.'
So she left out, and I went outside and got her a cab. So, sure enough, she came back one time I gettin' ready to get off. We's
closin' up. She pull up in a cab, say, "You don't have to get no cab. I got one."
